faqs.question: Can I take admission in ICT Mumbai MBA without MAH MBA CET?
faqs.answer: No, ICT Mumbai MBA admissions are purely entry-based. Thus, students seeking admission to this programme must have a valid MAH MBA CET score. Based on these scores, students are ranked and allocated a seat.

college_info.intro:
The Institute of Chemical Technology ICT Mumbai extends a number of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes across streams such as Engineering, Technology, Pharmaceutical Science, Allied Sciences, and Mathematics. Among the courses the ICT Mumbai BTech and MPharma are the flagship programmes of the institute and are extended in full-time mode across several specialisations.
Some of the popular BTech specialisations include Chemical Engineering, Dystuff Technology, Fibres and Textile Processing Technology and Food Engineering and Technology. While the ICT Mumbai MPharma programme has been accredited by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).
These two courses are highly sought-after among students and are popular as the specialty course of the institute with the campus having the proper infrastructural support in the form of labs, tools and industrial collaboration to make ICT Mumbai one of the best choices for BTech or MPharma in India. reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

review_content.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering (Food Engineering and Technology) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.

review_content.Placements: Almost 50% of the students have been placed in various companies. To date, the highest salary package offered is 21 lakhs, while the lowest is 6 lakhs. The top recruiting companies include Whole Truth Foods, Keva Flavor and Foods, Henkel, and BARC. Nearly every batch has secured placements with these companies. For internships, around 3 to 4 students are typically selected for top roles, including production manager, research and development positions, and chemical engineers.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Oils, Oleochemicals and Surfactants Technology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.

review_content.Placements: I believe over the years, placements have increased. The majority of students prefer to go outside India to pursue a master's Ph.D. Big companies like Godrej, Nerolac Paints, Asian Paints, and PPG come for campus placements. Over the years, the institute has been working towards achieving better placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: A Very Underrated Government College.

review_content.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

review_content.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.

review_content.Placements: The eligibility for placement is that you have to clear all subjects, and in the 7th semester, companies hire students based on performance in mock group discussions and interviews. The average placement offer is between 3-5 LPA. Companies like Glatt and Sun Pharma hire B Pharma students based on their requirements.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

review_summary.college_name: ICT Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

content.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering (Food Engineering and Technology) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.

content.Placements: Almost 50% of the students have been placed in various companies. To date, the highest salary package offered is 21 lakhs, while the lowest is 6 lakhs. The top recruiting companies include Whole Truth Foods, Keva Flavor and Foods, Henkel, and BARC. Nearly every batch has secured placements with these companies. For internships, around 3 to 4 students are typically selected for top roles, including production manager, research and development positions, and chemical engineers.
content.Infrastructure: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Oils, Oleochemicals and Surfactants Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.

content.Placements: I believe over the years, placements have increased. The majority of students prefer to go outside India to pursue a master's Ph.D. Big companies like Godrej, Nerolac Paints, Asian Paints, and PPG come for campus placements. Over the years, the institute has been working towards achieving better placements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A Very Underrated Government College.

content.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

content.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

The admission process for ICT Mumbai is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds and counselling process. A step-by-stepICT Mumbai admission processis as follows:
Step 1: ICT Mumbai Application Process

The admission process begins with filling out an online application form on the official website of the Institute of Chemical Technology (after clearing the entrance exam for respective courses). Candidates can apply for the course of their choice along with paying an application fee.
Step 2: ICT Mumbai Other Selection Rounds

Admission to ICT Mumbai courses is entrance-based. For entrance-based admission, candidates are required to qualify for entrance exams for the respective courses. Further, there are other selection rounds such as GDPI conducted as part of the selection process. For the MSc course, the ICT also conduct admission tests.
Step 3: ICT Mumbai Counselling Process/ Merit Release
Based on the scores in the respective entrance exams, past academic records and performance of candidates in other selection rounds, the university releases a merit list.
Step 4: Provisional Admission Notice

After the release of the merit list, a provisional admission notice will be sent to the selected candidates. Later on, candidates can proceed with the other admission formalities such as fee payment and document verification (if required). For more details about the final admission process, candidates may visit the official website of ICT Mumbai.

description: ICT Mumbai cutoff 2025 is available on this page for B.Tech admission. Candidates can view the ICT Mumbai JEE Main cutoff 2025 in the exam-wise sections below across different specialisations, rounds, and categories. Further, the latest exam-related events are below:

ICT Mumbai cutoff 2025 was released via MHT CET entrance exam for admission to the B.E. / B.Tech course. For the General AI category students, the last round cutoff range was between 22361 and 40921 for B.E. / B.Tech admission. Considering the lowest cutoff rank of 22361, Bachelor of Chemical Engineering turned out to be the most competitive branch for admission. In the first round, the cutoff rank for the same branch was 15337.
Considering the JEE Main last round cutoff 2025 for the General AI category students, the top most competitive course for admission was B.E. / B.Tech, with a cutoff rank closing at 22361.
For more categories, rounds and quotas, candidates must use the provided filters.
Some of the important dates related to JEE Main 2026 for admission are provided below. Candidates can keep track of the upcoming dates to be eligible for admission.
The cutoff PDFs below can be downloaded to view the cutoff details of the last three years for multiple rounds. This will help students understand the past years' cutoff trends.

To make an informed decision students must compare different colleges accepting JEE Main for admission. The given below comparison data is based on the JEE Main last round cutoff data. The cutoff is for the General AI category.

During ICT Mumbai cutoff 2023, the last round closing score was 99.32 for Bachelor of Chemical Engineering. In 2022 and 2021, the last round closing scores stood at 98.91 and 99.33, respectively for Bachelor of Chemical Engineering. Considering the Round 3 closing scores for Bachelor of Chemical Engineering over the past three years, Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai has witnessed a fluctuating trend.

nirf.description:
As per the overall score, ICT Mumbai has been placed at a good position by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 8 ranks to #64 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 5 ranks to #40 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, ICT Mumbai's rank is #41, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute's ranks in the 'Pharmacy' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, ICT Mumbai fell 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking.

hostel.description: ICT has five hostel blocks on the campus including 3 boys and 2 girls hostels. The total number of hostel accommodation seats available for the students at the ICT is nearly 855 (for all courses and years) including 210 lady students.

library.description: Institute of Chemical Technology's library has a collection of 77102 books, bound volumes and reports, 4848 theses, 125 journals (printed) and 5 databases. It performs a dual role of an academic library as well as a research library. It is housed in a separate ground plus two-storied building and follows a completely open-access concept. The library is fully computerized using the library management software called Libsys. It can be termed as a hybrid library with the best collection of printed and digital documents. The library is also a member of E-ShodhSindhu Consortium. The library has a facility of circulation service, reference and referral service, current awareness service, bibliographic service, photocopying service, user orientation programs, e-resources training programs and book bank service.

reviews.review_heading: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada CampusReviewed on 16 Feb 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada Campus.
reviews.review_text: The college has 24/7 Wi-Fi, well-established labs, and classrooms have a mike, project speakers, and a blackboard with each AC. The mess and canteen have good food the mess is cooperative. The hostel also has Wi-Fi 24/7, and a cleaning lady is there washing machine good hostel. We also have sports events teach events, and cultural events.

reviews.review_heading: Not just any other college, institute of culture, or institute of tradition.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped and have all the amenities. The most important is the lab. There is no lab facility like what ICT have. The hostel has all amenities including washing machines. The cleaning staff is also good and very supportive. It is one of the most comfortable stays.

reviews.review_heading: A Very Underrated Government College.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.

reviews.review_heading: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.

reviews.review_heading: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Institute of Chemical Technology, Marathwada CampusReviewed on 25 Sep 2024)
reviews.review_heading: The college for fortunate students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor because the actual campus of ICT Jalna college is under construction, so, at the moment, the college infrastructure is not that good and is rental. Although it's good if you're more focused on education instead of infrastructure. Regarding labs and classrooms, they are very good; all labs are equipped, and all the instruments are new and good. Classrooms are also good, with ACs and digital classroom logistics.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for chemical engineering fields.
reviews.review_text: Quality of the food in the mess is quite good as compared to other college's mess, and the canteen is even better and also not too expensive. For sports, basketball, volleyball, Badminton court is there and also turf is there for football. As such medical facilities are not there.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for Masters in pharma.
reviews.review_text: The college  infrastructure and campus is really cool. We have many labs in the college along with a new incubation centre which was developed this year. 24 hours Wi-Fi service is available in the college. They also provide a digital library which can be accessed from any location. College hostel has limited seats providing triple sharing rooms having separate beds, tables, fans, and water filter facilities. Mess food was decent in quality but the canteen’s food is really good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by IndianOil Odisha Campus, Bhubaneswar, Institute of Chemical Technology, MumbaiReviewed on 16 Apr 2024)
reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are of top level with 24 hrs electricity and Wi-Fi availability. The classrooms, library, and the labs are fully air conditioned Hostels provides room with 4 students sharing each room having attach washrooms. Washing machines are provided for washing clothes. Food quality is also good in the mess. Our college is tied up with KIIMS for medical facilities. There are issues with outdoor games like cricket and basketball as we are currently in a temporary campus and do not have access to...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and great college.
reviews.review_text: Life on campus is lively, with a good social life and many clubs to join. The infrastructure was really good, with a well-stocked library and big classrooms. We have an annual fest called Vortex. Many enjoyable moments and events are held here. The hostel needs to be good; the accommodation is average and the food is also not good. Management needs to take care of these things.

reviews.review_heading: About My Masters from ICT Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The campus and classes were clean and green, but the campus area was small. For many events, management is done by seniors; every month we have at least one event. Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and a library is present in the college. We can bring any book from there. The hostel is big, but getting admission is challenging, given the merit list. As a South Indian here, food is different, but I have no other option.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai (ICT).
reviews.review_text: The campus houses numerous clubs and societies. Several events are conducted throughout the year that benefit students in terms of sports. The ICT campus has badminton, cricket, and football courts. The hostel rooms are very clean and properly equipped with two, three, or four beds. Mess food is good in quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for research in Chemical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent when it comes to classrooms, but other facilities like labs, libraries, and research centers are excellent. It has a huge library where students can also access the books online through their portals. If you are genuinely interested in research in the chemical domain, this is heaven for you. Also recently, the M Mokashi incubation center was inaugurated, where you can work on your startup ideas. The sports and games facility, mess and canteen are good.

reviews.review_heading: I have done my masters in chemistry. I am fully satisfied with my college, which includes facilities
reviews.review_text: 24 hour Wi-Fi facility is available, and there are 4 hostels, and every hostel has an individual study room and a 2nd floor library full of all required books and journals. The hostel facility is so far so good. We all know Mumbai is so costly, so accommodation is the big issue, so yes, it is a bit congested.

review_content.Placements: There is no such good placement in this college. Only a few small-cap companies come to college, and they don't offer any teaching roles. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it provides very good placements and infrastructure.

content.Placements: CV Raman University is one of the best universities in Bihar. The atmosphere and faculty members are too good and responsible. In BBA, the average percentage of marks is 70.3%. They give placements of approximately 3.60 LPA. They give placements in Infosys, TCS, and all.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available here like Wi-Fi is too good. Classrooms are also good. Library has a lot of books and e-books. Canteen food quality is also good. They have medical facilities. We also have a playground for NCC and many more in our university. Overall, very good university in Bihar.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This college has value for money.

content.Placements: According to fee charges, placements are good. There is an increase in number of companies visitng the campus every year. Overall, college is good from a placement point of view. The maximum salary package offered is 8 LPA. Around 100% of students secured internships from our college and course.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is decent. Wi-Fi is available in every department. Classrooms are very big and the library is also available. Hostel and canteen facilities are available in our college.
content.Faculty: In our college, teachers are helpful and qualified. Their knowledge level is very high. Our college makes students industry-ready. Assignments and projects are designed accordingly to make students industry-ready. Semester exams are decent.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It gives you only a degree, and not skills.

content.Placements: There is no placement in the university. Very few student get placement with the help of external place. All students get internship for 45 days in local forms. And the internship is unpaid. Roles offered in the BBA course are marketing, HR, and financial management .
content.Infrastructure: The classroom and library are good but there is no facility for the hostel and no Wi-Fi. You can easily get a private room at a lower price near the college. Some games and sports are available like kabaddi, cricket, and chess. And college also conducts the NCC training.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I would not recommend joining this college for the Computer Science stream or for hostel students.

content.Placements: Almost 100% of students in the Electrical, Mechanical, and Electronics branches got placed in the 2-2.4 LPA package, whereas in another branch, only 50% of Civil and 20-25% of CSE students secured placements. The highest package offered is 6 LPA, the lowest is 1 LPA, and the average package is 2.2 LPA. Most students secured positions in startups, as no MNCs visit our college for placement drives.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is smaller compared to other engineering colleges/universities, but a new building is under construction. There is a very small canteen on campus, and the classrooms are of good quality. The library is world-class, but campus Wi-Fi access is limited. There is a small sports cell and a large cricket playground. As of 2023, hostel and mess facilities were not provided, but these amenities are planned for the future.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The story of my university.

content.Placements: As per my journey in this university and experience, if they passed in all semesters, they are eligible to get placement by giving the interview to the various companies. The highest package placement depends upon the roles and responsibilities; however, I somewhere knew the highest package is 550000 p. a. Various companies across the country comes to offer placements to the students. The recruiters are L&T, Axis Bank, Mahindra, etc. Every student is required to do an internship program for at least 2 months. The top role offered is bank PO.
content.Infrastructure: This university was established in, I think, 2018 so the infrastructure is still in under process but the finished building and play ground are impressive. In this university, there are separate blocks for the civil department and the commerce department, which makes it easy for students to reach the targeted place.

admission_process.title: Dr CV Raman University Bihar Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: DR CV Raman University is a UGC-recognised University. The university provides courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate and diploma levels under five faculties, including the Faculty of Commerce and Management, Faculty of Arts & Humanities, Faculty of Science, Faculty of Computer Science & IT and Faculty of Agriculture. The university offers a total of 64 courses across seven streams. It offers numerous degrees and research courses in the discipline of Engineering, Management, Arts & Humanities and so on. Some of the popular courses offered at the Dr. C.V. Raman University.

For DR CV Raman University admissions to various UG & PG courses, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria, followed by course-specific selection criteria. The final admission to the courses offered at DR CV Raman is merit-based. The course-wise eligibility and selection criteria of DR CV Raman University admissions 2025 are below:

Dr CV Raman University admissions 2025 are primarily merit-based, with some courses requiring entrance exams. Candidates must fulfil all the selection criteria to be eligible for admission. Find below the detailed process for CVRU admissions 2025:
Dr. C.V. Raman University Application Process 2025

The 2025 admission process of Dr. C.V. Raman University starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application form from the official website or obtain it from the admission office. The duly filled application form can be submitted online or in person at the university. The application fee must be paid online, and candidates need to attach the payment receipt with the application form.
Selection Rounds

Admission to UG and PG courses at Dr. C.V. Raman University is primarily based on merit. Candidates are selected based on their performance in the last qualifying examination. For certain courses, entrance exams may be required. The details of such entrance exams will be available on the university’s official website. Also, candidates have to meet the minimum eligibility criteria for their desired course.
Merit List Release & Counselling

After completing the application and selection rounds, candidates must appear for the counselling process for their respective courses. The university will release the merit list of selected candidates in various rounds. Students whose names appear on the merit list need to pay the required fee to secure their seat.

admission_process.title: SOET CMR University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: SOET CMR University admissionsare primarily entrance-based. SOET is a school under CMR University. The school offers courses in the Engineering stream at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels. The programmes offered atSOET CMR Universityinclude BTech, MTech, and PhD. Interested candidates can apply online for their preferred course.

SOET CMR University offers 10 courses in full-time and part-time mode. Candidates have to either qualify an entrance exam or fulfil the merit requirements to get admission. The university conducts CMRUAT for admission to BTech and MTech courses. Below are theSOET CMR University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

School of Engineering and Technology considers entrance exam scores for admission. The admissions are open, and candidates can apply online for the preferred course. Below are the steps to get a seat in the school:
Step 1: SOET CMR University Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply on the official website of the university. Aspirants have to first register with the basic details and then fill out the application form. Candidates have to pay an application fee to register for a course.
Step 2: Selection

CMR University conducts an entrance exam, CMRUAT, for admission to BTech and MTech courses. The school also considers KCET, JEE, or COMEDK for the BTech programme. The university also conducts an entrance test for PhD admission. Selected candidates have to come for the personal interview round.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

Selected candidates are provided provisional offer letter. Once shortlisted, aspirants have further come for document verification and pay theSOET CMR University feeto confirm their seat in the school.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good for talented students.
reviews.review_text: We have good faculty members with high-speed Wi-Fi connection and a good library with all knowledgeable books and computers. We have extracurricular activities like sports and all, and good food in the hostel, and we have medical facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely I am satisfied. This campus is most beautiful as I have seen.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in our college are quite good. They provide free Wi-Fi, free bus transportation to the nearest bus stand, and to the hostel during lunch hours. In the hostel, we get free Wi-Fi, and we enjoy together. We get non-veg weekly twice Sunday and Wednesday.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and the service provided by the faculty in academics.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is well-maintained, and the games are conducted on a weekly basis. Wi-Fi is a little bit problematic, and the education is good, as well as the innovation activities are provided very effectively. The canteen is also well-maintained, and almost all students love to go to the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a good choice if your budget is within 15 lakhs for a management seat.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and smart boards are available in each classroom. When it comes to the library, many books are available, written by well-experienced authors. Separate grounds are available for each game, like Cricket, Basketball, Football, and many others. Also, the food in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure and events don't matter; it's about the friends you make.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good because all courses (B. Tech, MS, BCA, MCA, etc.) have students in the same building, and there is no auditorium. The hostel facilities are good, and there are 2 canteens in the college building. Medical facilities are available but a little expensive. Regarding sports, there is a basketball court, football ground, and volleyball court.

reviews.review_heading: Not that much; the previous year was the worst. No placements took place.
reviews.review_text: It is very good and fantastic, very good food and amazing. The hostel is fantastic, the sports are good, and the amazing basketball court is very good. The cricket stadium is fantastic, and now the football ground is being made. The athletics facilities are fantastic, and there are drawing competitions.

reviews.review_heading: CMR University campus review.
reviews.review_text: They have good lab facilities and a very good environment. A cricket ground, they provide tasty hostel food. Library, you get all their resources, but you need to pay a fine if the book is not returned in time. The hostel is good, but it is highly expensive. 1.3L per year is the fee.

reviews.review_heading: Is CMRU really worth it!
reviews.review_text: The college does not give access to Wi-Fi in campus. It is only for the faculty members and there will be no mobile signal consistency. Classrooms have digital boards and proper ventilation in all the classrooms. Canteen's food is decent and good enough for the price we pay but there is no variety. We feel odd eating same thing all the time.

reviews.review_heading: CMRU is not a right choice for learners with true intent.
reviews.review_text:
The hygiene of the campus is well-maintained with no complaints in that regard. The classrooms are equipped with smart boards for digital learning. Practical labs like Physics and Chemistry are well-stocked with necessary equipment. Still, there is no Wi-Fi facility available on the campus for students except in the hostels. Hostel food is manageable, though not always commendable.

The library is well-equipped with course-related books and has a spacious, organized reading area. The computer la...

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good and even we can use it
reviews.review_text: Labs are good , classrooms are good but no wifi facility will be provided, you can stay in library and can access it without any additional fees you can even access gym. Labs have wifi you can use it but no personal wifi will be provided. Hostel is good with good canteen.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, but traveling might get difficult.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work and is not available for students, and network connectivity is poor due to the remote location. The classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors, and the hostel food is improving and satisfactory. Sports and games facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: School of Engineering and Technology, CMR University review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the hostel is quite good, with Wi-Fi and a library. However, the students living in the hostel are very rude. The food quality is good, but the mess is not clean, and there is a lack of sporting equipment. Also, there is a problem with the water that is causing my hair to fall out.

reviews.review_heading: The ultimate Review on the CMR University.
reviews.review_text:
The college has free Wi-Fi for the students and consists of a big library and classrooms.
The hostel infrastructure is good with very healthy food options.
The college library consists of various books related to the course and various story books and novels.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements and well qualified faculty at the college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good-quality infrastructure for the CSE course. The college had good-quality facilities for the students of our course. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, etc. facilities were given to the students. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students. Hostel rooms were furnished. Mess and canteen food were good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: All the facilities are of good quality.
reviews.review_text: It is satisfactory both for the course part and the hostel part. We have our hostel on campus only and mess. The facilities provided are AC, laundry, cleaning, medical, recreational space, etc. There are few places where sports can be played. There is a library and Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied and happy with my college and I would recommend anyone to join here.

individual_reviews.title: Poor faculty despite good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Many students in my class, about 60% of the students, are placed so far. The highest package last seen in 2014 was about 14.5 LPA, and the average, the lowest, is about 4 LPA. faqs.answer: Gondwana University may provide direct admission to second year of a few programme. However, the regular admission is entrance or merit-based. The university considers entrance exams such as MAH CET, MHT CET, CAT, MAT, etc. for admission to specific programmes. faqs.question: How can candidates join Gondwana University?
faqs.answer: Gondwana University offers admission based on MHT CET, MAH CET, CAT, MAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. faqs.question: Are admissions at Gondwana University entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Gondwana University admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The university considers entrance exams such as MAH CET, MHT CET, CAT, MAT, JEE Main, etc. for admission to BE, MBA, BPharm and other courses. The merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam is considered for BCom, MCom, BCA, BBA, etc. Once selected, the university releases a merit list on the university website.

faqs.question: Can I apply for admission to various courses at Gondwana University with 50% in Class 12?

The university may consider entrance exam score along with eligibility for a few UG programmes.

reviews.review_heading: Good for enjoying and getting jobs. It provides good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: College review according to students.

reviews.review_heading: College is best if you get an EAMCET seat.
reviews.review_text: We don't have Wi-Fi for any personal use. The food quality is good for what you pay. College environment is good and clean. If you are looking to join this college you can completely go regarding infrastructure and the college.

reviews.review_heading: There is no campus, and teachers are below average.

The canteen is big, but the maintenance is horrible; all the tables are dirty, and you have to search for a clean table, which is very rare to find. The food and snacks are pretty good, but the hostel food is really bad, which is why students shift to PGs.

reviews.review_heading: I'm not satisfied because of our college, but I don't know about placement. Infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: We are not satisfied with the teaching of some teachers.
reviews.review_text: We are not getting proper food in hostels. We need to get permission even to go out for one day. The food cost is high in hostels. The hostel fee is around Rs. 6,000-7,000 per month. There are network issues in particular places.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with teaching but the fests and festivals are often conducted.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and library are good. Wi-Fi is fully available in our college. Library is good and all books and materials are available. There is no hostel food. College has a huge campus where we can still study. Van facilities are available for students.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, placements are good and good internship training are also provided.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of the classroom is good; the Wi-Fi facilities are there.
They provide separate library classes and also provide lab classes.
The hostel facility is also good. The neatness is also good, and the food is also good in a mess.
There is a canteen and the items are good.

reviews.review_heading: I think college is good enough to join if you want average jobs.

content.Placements: Placements at CIMAGE are decent but mostly limited to small and mid-level IT companies. Around 60-70% of BCA students get placed every year. So students from outside Patna stay in nearby PGs or rented rooms, which are easily available. Overall, the infrastructure supports focused study and professional development.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It's worth the money paid, I am fully satisfied.

content.Placements: Due to the recession in the job market, there were not many employment opportunities. Students were given marketing jobs, and they mainly focused on them. All students have done internships in more than 2 companies. The college started almost 59 years ago.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college was mediocre. There was no specific women's hostel, which was a bit difficult because students staying in the college hostel could lodge a complaint against the college authorities, but it was not possible to do so while staying in the private hostel. The lab facilities were not good, but the campus had a peaceful atmosphere.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: 20% of students are placed. Top recruiters are Wipro, TCS, and Infosys. If u don't have supply, opportunities will be vast. College also provides internships but that is not much good you rather pick a good company to do an internship that is more good.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for every department are very helpful and excellent. Hostel facilities are only provided for boys which is the only drawback about hostel facilities. They provide different clubs for showcasing four skills.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College is good, but some rules are dissatisfied. Placements opportunities are comparatively lower.

content.Placements: Around 15% to 20% of students from my department are placed. The package they offer is around Rs. 15,000 to 25,000 per month, and the roles are different companies, like customer service, tax analyst, etc. The top recruiting companies are TCS, EY, Deloitte, Accenture, MyCaptain, Hedge Equities, SBI Fellowships, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good infrastructure, including an open gym, Radio B.M.C. library, seminar hall, auditorium, canteen, college bus, grounds, cricket nets, football turf, basketball court, garden, parking facilities, etc. They are fully supportive of improving sports and game activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied as the primary facilities regarding tuition and arts, sports.

content.Placements: Around 40% have placement rate and from last batch of 41 students, 23 were placed, Information Park is the main placement institution. As the college is situated in a highly urban area, there are many institutions and companies nearby, the college offers internships to any of the companies and the companies have a direct placement interest in the students. Top roles offered include lab technician, assistant accountant, and other experience-gaining jobs for the passed-out students as their internships.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are available, during the last batch a research center was also established. Lab quality is pretty satisfactory, but the research lab quality is very high. Mess quality is pretty awesome, medical facilities are carried out properly. The college is really wide, defined in sports and games. But the huge participation of students sometimes makes the selection tough.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college has a really good environment.

content.Placements: Placements in the college are very good. So many opportunities were provided for us so we can grab the actual one for us in the present time and it's completely worth choosing this college that's why we get good placements in the best companies in India.
content.Infrastructure: The library of the college is very natural; it feels like home in there, and my friends used to hang out there in our free time for reading and combined studies. It's the best days of our lives. They are great, the teachers, faculty, and every bit of the college.

reviews.review_text: The library of the college is very natural; it feels like home in there, and my friends used to hang out there in our free time for reading and combined studies. It's the best days of our lives. They are great, the teachers, faculty, and every bit of the college.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with skilled teachers and good infrastructure facilities.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are provided by the college. There is Wi-Fi facility throughout the college, 4 or 5 labs, and a large library, including an e-library. Hostel service is also provided, but that is not satisfactory, as is the canteen food quality. Our college gives importance to sports and games, and sports day and other sports events are conducted yearly.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching facilities and infrastructure facilities .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure facilities of the commerce department are good. Wi - fi is provided for students. Every class has a smart class facility. The library is also available at any time during our college hours. The college also provides us with a platform for various sports.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and placements. Great infrastructure and extracurricular.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like labs, libraries, canteens, classrooms, etc. are available. There is a ground and a physical education department available. Extracurriculars like NCC and NSS are there. The food in the canteen is good at a reasonable price. There is a small shop called Chain and Chat that one can get snacks from .

reviews.review_heading: The best three years of my life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is okay. There is no public Wi-Fi, and hostel facilities are available, which is good. Hostel facilities are available for both men and women. The hostels are not on campus but outside, very near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Simple yet memorable college life.
reviews.review_text: The college does have basic infrastruce that is necessary, meanwhile there is still room for improvement. Department funding is very poor and could improve in many ways. The campus area is pretty green and calming. The taste and quality of college mess and canteen is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Since the college was approved for a master's degree in Space Science, the number of already existing classes was not enough to accommodate the extra number of students who would join each year. We did not have a hostel facility in our college. The canteen was good and we had a really good physical education department.

reviews.review_heading: I am averagely satisfied being a student of the covid batch.
reviews.review_text: There is a huge library and good classrooms with visual classes in our college. There is Wi-Fi access but with limited data. Being a batch entered during the pandemic, we weren't much familiar with the campus as we had more online classes.

reviews.review_heading: Placements of our college are highly satisfactory. The ambience of our college is very good.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are high-tech, and each class is provided with a projector and a laptop. Every student has their own chair and writing pad. There are a lot of books and magazines in the library, which helps students. The college is giving equal importance to sports and games also.

reviews.review_heading: Best quality education with qualified and experienced faculties. Good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Good campus atmosphere. Air-cooled classrooms. Wi-Fi facility. Separate library for MBA department. Computer lab facility available as per the needs of students. Canteen run by outside agency. Sports day conducted every year. Gym and Medical facility available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, and it is worth the money paid.
reviews.review_text: The college had an average infrastructure. There was no particular ladies hostel. It was a bit difficult because the students who reside in the college hostel can raise a complaint against the college authorities, but this cannot be done while residing in a private hostel. lab facilities were not good. There was a peaceful atmosphere on campus.

review_content.Placements: Our college provides 100% placements. The salary packages are increasing every year. review_summary.college_name: SNDT Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Accountancy - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college with trusted.

content.Placements: Smt. Maniben M. P Shah College of Arts and Commerce for Women has good placements given from the Bafi Bachelor of accounting finance and Insurance department. They are 100 percent trusted for the placement. Students get placement at bank etc. That helps students to get more information about banks, insurance and finance.
content.Infrastructure: There are many courses in the college. College has many circular activities for the students. There are game facilities for indoor and outdoor games like badminton, chess, carrom, cricket and etc. The library is also very big and offers lots of books and in the library there are computers to find information or for presentations.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Usha Mittal Institute Of Technology (SNDT Women's University).

content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students got placed every year. The highest package is 32 LPA by Visa, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA by mass recruiters. Top companies are Visa, Deutsche Bank, Oracle, Barclays, Bank of America, Deloitte, Infosys, etc. Only 10 students get the internship though in third year but almost 30-40 percent of students get internships in fourth year of college in companies like GE Aerospace, Colgate, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of college is good. It's newly renovated. They have a hostel too. It's four sharing and two sharing occupancies. The mess food is average. College has a gym too. They have a basketball court but not many facilities for other sports. You can play badminton in the foyer.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are very helpful. My principal MS Abhilasha Agarwal is also very supportive.

content.Placements: I completed my B.Com from Vanita Vishram College. During our time, there was COVID-19, and although there was a placement opportunity, only about 15 to 20% of students participated. After earning my B.Com, I found roles as an admin and accountant as a fresher. The B.Com program covers various subjects like accounting, environmental studies, economics, and banking, which helped me learn different skills.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were big. There was a good vibe in the library too. I did not stay in the hostel so I cannot tell you about it, but some of my friends stayed there, it is very safe. The canteen area was also big. The food was also good. We did a lot of activities on the college campus. I remember the blood donation camps exactly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Where you will find the three teachers you wanted.

content.Placements: These years, many girl students from different states took admission in Usha Mittal for B.Tech programme. Nearly 80 percent of the students got placed in my course. It is an autonomous college. The academics are pretty chill. 32 LPA is the highest package offered for the CST branch, while 12 LPA could be the average. Companies like Infosys, Visa, Bank of America, and many more have their placement interview here. From the CST branch, almost 80 percent of students get placed in a few good companies. Talking about roles offered, companies like Visa and Infosys do hire students for their highest package.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great college, decent feel, easy life, and good placements.

content.Placements: Software Developer, Software Analyst, Software Engineer, etc., are jobs you can expect here. The placement is quite good. You can see a variety of companies here. The highest package this year is 36 LPA, the lowest is 4.4 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college is decent, not too fancy, but it has 6 labs, 2–3 libraries, a basketball court, clean washrooms, etc. The canteen is also decent. Medical facilities are good. The college has its own sports council, and activities are encouraged here, so no need to worry about that.

admission_process.title: SNDT Mumbai Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Shreemati Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Women’s University,also known as SNDT University, admissionis both merit and entrance-based. The college acceptsMAH CET, XAT, JEE Main, etc,for admission to the UG and PG courses. The University has three campuses, one each inChurchgate, Santacruz, and Pune. The Juhu campus has more than 15 professional and technical institutions with eight adjoining buildings. The campus offers various PG and PG diploma programmes in different fields such as Engineering, Management, Arts, Education, Technology, Communication, and many more. These courses are offered under 19 different departments, namely the Department of Computer Science, Department of Education Management, Department of Technology, and more.

SNDT Women's University admission is entrance-based to most of its UG and PG courses. Candidates have to meet the basic eligibility requirements of the respective courses to apply for the desired programme. Check below the eligibility criteria, accepting entrance exams, and more for the SNDT College course admissions:
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

SNDT University's fee structuremay include components such as Registration Fee, Tuition Fees, Development Fees, Alumni Fee, etc. Further,SNDT seat allocationis done through the counselling bodies of the respective courses. Check out the SNDT fees and seats for popular UG & PG courses:
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

For admission to SNDT University, candidates must complete the entire admission process as per the college's admission guidelines. The process is mainly conducted online, hence, students must apply online at the official website of the university. Before applying for the desired programme, students must fulfil the admission criteria for the same. Find below the step-wise SNDT University admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Candidates must fill out the online application form by visiting the SNDT's official website (sndt.ac.in / https://sndt.digitaluniversity.ac). Once the application form is complete, candidates must take a print-out of the online form, attach Xerox copies of final year mark sheets of the qualifying exam of the applied course, and submit them to the Department Office.
Step 2: SNDT Shortlisting

The application forms are scrutinised based on the eligibility criteria of the course. Once found eligible, the Department will send a Google form link to the registered, eligible candidates via mail to the email addresses provided by the applicant. The candidate must fill out the form as accurately as possible; in case of errors, the application will not be processed further.

Step 3: Merit List and Document Verification:Once the merit list is published, selected candidates will receive notification via phone and email. They will be required to appear in person for document verification. Bring the online application form, original marksheets, and certificates for verification.
Step 4: SNDT Merit list/Final selection

The college releases a merit list of selected candidates. The candidates will be informed the same telephonically as well as via email wherein they will be called offline for document verification along with their online application form and original marksheets & certificates. After document verification, the candidates will proceed to pay the fees with the admin clerk

paragraphs: RGPV offers a total of fifty courses at UG, PG and PhD levels. These courses are offered across fields, namelyEngineering, Management, Architecture, ScienceandPharmacy.Students can enrol in regular or distance mode for the courses offered (if available).

Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya course admissions 2025is both merit and entrance-based for its courses. Candidates who get selected through merit are offered direct admission, while those who apply via scores of the entrance exam have to appear for a counselling process. Find the complete details aboutRGPV admission process 2025in the following section:
Step 1: Application Process

Candidates applying for admission to courses offered at constituent colleges of RGPV are required to apply via the DTE MP counselling process after qualifying for the respective entrance exams. Whereas, for admission to affiliated colleges of RGPV, candidates must apply on the official website concerned colleges.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Candidates seeking admission to courses such as BTech, MTech, MBA, BPharm, etc., must qualify for the respective national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, CMAT, etc. These courses are taught via the university's constituent colleges. Whereas for admission to courses such as B.Ed, BSc, BCA, etc., admission is completely based on the merit scores of candidates obtained in previous qualifying exams. These courses are taught at the affiliated colleges of RGPV.
Step 3: Counselling Process

Once the selection rounds are done, candidates who qualify and meet the RGPV cutoff for the selectively accepted exam have to apply for the DTE MP Counselling process for the final seat allotment. After the release of the final merit lists, candidates have to visit the university's admission office in person for document verification.

The food sometimes doesn’t seem good in taste, but generally it’s decent, and hostel timings are an issue because we are prohibited from leaving the hostel after 7:30.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Institute of Engineering and Science, IPS AcademyReviewed on 21 Jan 2026)

reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. We have smart classrooms, a library, labs with all equipment used in practicals, and Wi-Fi. To be honest, you should take admission in this college if you want a decent college, and the quality is also good in hostels.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Lakshmi Narain College of Technology, BhopalReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Best private college for placement, but the overall campus life is very mediocre.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs in our college, and every single one of them has ethernet connection. The library has Wi-Fi for studying. One drawback is that you can't use a laptop or mobile in the classroom, even if you are using it for studying. The hostel is well-maintained and clean. The mess food is not very good, and the sports facilities are average since the ground is not very well taken care of. The hostel is only allotted for 1st year to boys, while girls can stay for the duration of their course...

reviews.review_heading: The curriculum is very relevant, but placement records are not as expected.

Wi-Fi is not available for students on campus, only in labs and sports facilities. Hostel rooms are big and are in pretty good condition mess food is decent.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by NRI Institute of Information Science and TechnologyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because it is value for money and the faculty members are very good-natured.

paragraphs: S-Vyasa University admission 2025is merit-based for all courses. The University offers multiple undergraduate, postgraduate and diploma courses in various streams such as Commerce, Management, Science and Yoga, Computer Applications, etc. AICTE approves all theS-VYASA courses. Candidates seeking admission to S-Vyasa University courses must apply to their desired courses before the deadline. The application process is conducted online on the official website of the University.

Candidates seeking admission toS-Vyasa Universitymust meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and then apply for their desired course through the University's official website. The table below shows the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for allS-VYASA courses:
Make your selection here, to check the eligibility and selection criteria for other S-Vyasa University courses.

S-Vyasa University admission process is a multi-step process. It begins with the release of application forms on the official website and ends with the payment of admission fees by the shortlisted candidates. The steps-wise complete admission process for S-Vyasa University courses is mentioned below:
Step 1: Application Process

The S-VYASA application forms are released online on the official website of the University. Eligible candidates are required to visit the official website and fill out the application form before the deadline.
Step 2: Shortlisting of Candidates
The selection criteria for all courses is merit-based i.e., the candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the qualifying exam.
Step 3: Results and Admission Confirmation
Selected candidates will be notified about their admission. They need to pay the admission confirmation fees and appear for the document verification round to book their seats.

paragraphs: ITM University, Gwalior admission 2025 is open. The institute offers a wide range of UG, PG, Integrated, Diploma and PhD courses through its different schools namely— theSchool of Engineeringand Technology, Computer Applications, Management, Education, Art & Design, Science, Physical Education and Law.ITM Universityaccepts admissions to its courses on an entrance basis. Students need to clear the institute's entrance test;ITM NEST. The institute also accepts valid scores obtained by the candidates in other national-level exams, such as CAT, CMAT, and more. Aspirants can get all the details regarding the admission procedure, criteria, scholarships, and courses offered at the university in the following article.

ITM University Gwalioroffers admissions to its courses based on the entrance exam conducted by the university. It also accepts valid scores obtained in national-level entrance exams. ITM University admission for some courses is granted on the basis of valid scores in the national/state-level entrance exams. The university also conducts its own entrance exam—ITM NEST for admission to the majority of the courses. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria forITM University Gwalior courses:

The admission procedure for ITM University includes several steps, such as application, selection, and admission confirmation. The college accepts admissions to its programmes on scores obtained by the students in the entrance exams. Interested candidates can visit the college's official website to obtain the application form. The entire application process is online. Below is the step-wiseadmission process of ITM University:
Step 1: ITM University Application Process

Interested candidates who fulfil the specified eligibility can visit the official website of ITM University to fill out the application form online. Candidates need to select the desired course, fill in all the specified details, pay the application fee and upload the required documents to complete the registration. Students can either purchase the application form from the admission campus or choose to fill out the form online.
Step 2: ITM University Selection Process

ITM University shortlists applicants on the basis of merit obtained in entrance exams such as JEE Main, CAT, and CMAT. For some of the courses, written tests, interviews, and group discussions will be conducted and will be considered for admissions, with due consideration of academic records and work experience.
Step 3: Counselling and Fee Payment

Once the candidates are shortlisted, they will have to go through counselling for seat allocation. The shortlisted candidates will have to pay the course fee and submit the required documents to confirm their seat in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Peaceful campus and good teaching, but limited agriculture-specific opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are very decent, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7. In the hostel, beds and rooms are very good. Food is good compared to others. The hostel is on campus with security and basic amenities. The college conducts sports every week.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the infrastructure, faculty, and the MD.
reviews.review_text: Girls hostel was good, neat, and clean. The only thing was that the housekeeping staff did not clean inside the rooms due to security reasons. The guards were also good. The new hostel was better than the old one, but there were fewer rooms, so you need to book early.

reviews.review_heading: I did not have a good experience. I am disappointed with it.
reviews.review_text: Now, I do not know what has changed but in my college time facilities are like nothing. Our class is on the top floor and in summer there are no coolers and fans do not work properly. There is no Wi-Fi at that time. The library is good.

reviews.review_heading: Expanding experiences. College life will be a roller coaster life for students. Live it once.
reviews.review_text: We have all the infrastructure and facilities like labs and library. But the classrooms lack lighting. There should be more light in the class. Wi-Fi is working but some places have less connectivity. We have all the good hostel facilities. But only the mess food varies from good to little good. We have good medical facilities as the ITM itself has its own hospital. To an extent little of the things are free.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and happening events.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides clean and developed laboratories, machinery, and all the equipment required for research. We also have a very vast sports department with all the varieties of sports.

reviews.review_heading: I liked ITM Campus. When you enter, you get to experience good infrastructure.

Classrooms are fully AC, and the classrooms have projectors too. Students can choose any 3 clubs in the university. Club activities include credit points that every student needs to maintain.

The canteen facilities are average. The college offers a solid educational foundation, particularly in the field of agriculture.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and campus experience.
reviews.review_text: The girls' hostel has two buildings, one with all triple and quadruple rooms and the other with only double rooms. The charges are quite high, around INR 90,000 for a double and INR 80,000 for a triple or quad. The hostel has a few faculty members, so students cannot make noise at night. If you want to live off campus, it will take about 20 minutes to get to school, a...

reviews.review_heading: Perks of the unwanted college but became my favourite .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of ITM is well defined and also the classrooms are average, but the library system of our college is one of the best libraries in such colleges around. The infrastructure also includes an open theatre called Naad and it has playgrounds for all outdoor sports. Also, it has little as well as a huge garden area for some personal events and other events organised by the clubs and the ITM itself.

reviews.review_heading: ITM University B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college looks so beautiful, but there are not many facilities at this college. I do not prefer the hostel of this college much. I don't feel the quality of the food at the canteen and mess is so good. I have no idea of medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied. Mobiles are not allowed in the campus. Good placements are now offered.
reviews.review_text: The library uses it sometimes only, not all the time we are reading the class notes, which will give the faculty. Wi-Fi is not available in all systems; it is only available in the faculty systems. Classrooms are cleaned every day, and our college maintains cleanliness on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amrita Sai Institute of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: All were good and we have different types of labs like cybersecurity labs, IoT labs, communication labs, etc. And we also have mechanical labs, civil labs, ECE labs and other activity labs and games, such as activity clubs yoga club and drama clubs, which can be easily adopted by students.

reviews.review_heading: Good for a degree but placements not upto the mark.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well and good. The classes are good to see and the environment is well. The washrooms and the canteens are reasonable. But are not up to the mark. Don't get your hopes up for this college. It is good but not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: Amrita Sai is good for making your future bright.
reviews.review_text: There are advanced lab facilities to provide real-time hands-on experience on the latest technologies like Cloud Computing, Ethical Hacking, Penetration Testing, Big Data Analytics, AI/ML, and IoT (Internet of Things). Employability-oriented and research-oriented training and guidance will be provided in Amrita Sai.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with its placements and salary packages.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not good, and most of the students prefer to take a room nearby our college. The food quality is average. Our campus environment is good.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, the placements condition is not good for the students.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is average. There is no proper ventilation for the students who are sitting in the classroom, and the power connection to this college is not good. The basic sanitary rooms are not good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is bad but good with activities like collecting money from the students.
reviews.review_text: Our college looks good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Wi-Fi is available over the college, and labs are also available. A library is also good with good books. The college has a hostel for only girl students, and good food is available in the canteen. Ground is also available for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Amrita Sai Institute of Science and Technology is a decent Autonomous college.
reviews.review_text: Library, classrooms and labs are pretty decent not so rich look. You can get all sort of books that an engineering student requires from the library. Labs are some what near to the reality if we correctly use it. Medical facilities are not so great. Canteen and ambiance is average but food is good enough. Sports and games facilities are quite good. They conduct all sort of sports and games during the annual day event and you can grab decent prizes too. Overall had a decent facilities but not so ...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college in all aspects and I would rate 4 out of 5.
reviews.review_text: There are no proper laboratories for the course, all those are not capable of students completing their works when coming to classrooms. The infrastructure is satisfactory and library is not much repository. I am a day scholar, so I do not know about the hostel facilities. The canteen and its hygiene are average. The activities like sports are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good. Teachers are really helpful for education and care about students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in our college are very decent and good for usage. We can use labs and the library as per our needs for research purposes. Classrooms were good, and hostels were good to stay in with a decent environment. The hostel provides very hygienic food for students.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good food and good classrooms with CCTV cameras. The quality of the facilities available in the hostel is good. The quality of food served in the canteen is good. The medical facilities are quite good. Sports and games are also quite good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities in our college are good. There are advanced labs and classrooms. The library has digital facilities. Hostel maintenance is good and the food served is also good. We have good medical facilities. The canteen food is good, and the sports are held daily.

faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer without a Law degree?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.
