reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and helpful teachers.
reviews.review_text: The MCA course offers a safe and good environment to learn with smart classrooms and labs, along with free Wi-Fi. There is also a library that contains a vast collection of books. In terms of the hostel, the food and accommodation are safe and secure. Medical facilities are also available. There are rooms for sports and games, and a fest is conducted every year.

reviews.review_heading: The College Has Very Good Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Kannur University has good infrastructure. The classrooms of the department are very good and free Wi-Fi is available. The college campus is also very big and beautiful. There is a hostel near the college. The food quality of the hostel is also very good. Medical facilities are available both in hostels and colleges.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college and our college has very good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available are outstanding. Students have access to free library, Wi-Fi and healthcare. Also, feels for course and hostel are negligible. The quality of hostels is very good, They provide best quality food. The college campus has a large playground where all kinds of outdoor games are .

reviews.review_heading: Overall Best University for MBA Course
reviews.review_text: Students were provided with all necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, a library, labs, classrooms, sports facilities, and medical services. The university campus was sprawling and included several athletic fields. The university hostel was conveniently located nearby. The mess offered quality food, although it was frequent.

reviews.review_heading: Review for Kannur University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were good. The labs had all the necessary instruments and the classrooms were spacious. There was a library in the college for students and a reading room was available in the library. The quality of facilities in our hostel was good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with world class facilities of this college and top notch infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All necessary facilities, including Wi-Fi, a library, labs, classrooms, sports facilities and medical services, were available to the students. There were several different sports facilities on the large college campus. Conveniently, the college hostel was close by. The food at the mess was of high quality, although several dishes were repeated.

reviews.review_heading: Kannur university Get a future ready degree.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities and infrastructure. New hi-teach classrooms with Wi-Fi and computers. The library is available. Hostel is good. Different types, very tasty and most hygienic food is available. Medical facilities are available and sports are emphasized on different days.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Kannur University.
reviews.review_text: The library has a collection of 44.153 books. Facilities available here are Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, smart classroom, hostel, ground, canteen, mess, and sweet house. The library has been serving the various of the university community viz, student, staff.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college have library. Open Wi-Fi. But Wi-Fi range is too slow. Good labs and systems are working good, Hostel is only for girls. All facilities are good. There is no space to sports and games. That is a big problem of our college. Other colleges have these facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The Malabar touch of Education.
reviews.review_text: The campus library is above average for finding useful texts for reading and reference. However, the placement of WiFi routers all over the campus is inadequate, and the signal strength is weak. The network is often irritable and does not help in browsing the internet. The canteen operates only until the evening, and the hostel facility is reserved for girls, leaving boys to find their own accommodations.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Kannur University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is 3-4 years old. They have been developing the classrooms. You can find Wi-Fi-enabled libraries. The libraries have books to read and many other facilities. The hostel food is delicious and hygienic. Regular sports and activities are conducted every evening. Facilities available here are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, smart classrooms, library, ground, hostel, mess, canteen and sweet house for refreshments.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Kannur University.
reviews.review_text: The library here has a collection of 44,154 books, 1,994 journalists, 37 E-journals and 337 theses. In this college, there is a swimming pool and indoor and outdoor stadium. There are good Wi-Fi, labs and classroom facilities. The hostel here is awesome, and quality food is available here.

The lowest salary package offered was 1.45 LPA. Students who secured 87% and above got internships by Cadila company.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has many facilities like free Wi-Fi and good internet, nice canteen, and their food is very good. Our classrooms are very professional. Our college has one huge playground to play different games. We have one sports teacher to teach us how to play.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Affordable college with best facilities .

content.Placements: The most offered roles in the placements are finance-related and also marketing-related. Multinational companies also come to our college for the placements and to recruit new freshers who are skilled and know the work information.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good, with huge buildings and the facilities of a canteen and fresh drinking water. The classroom also has a smartboard and a projector in very good condition. The benches are well maintained, and there is enough space for everyone to feel secured and satisfied.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Jul 2023)- B.Sc. + M.Sc. in Computer Application and Information Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college for a better future.

content.Placements: Our college provides internships and placements. Around 65% of students got placed in this course. The minimum salary package offered ranges between 5 LPA to 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys, Wipro, and Google. Almost 80% of students got internships at Wipro and other software companies. The top roles offered are developer, database administrator, human resource manager, and CEO.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is well-designed. It provides smart multimedia classes for students with Wi-Fi facilities. Laboratories and libraries are air-conditioned. Playground is available. The food served in the canteen is better. Hostel facilities are very good. Each hostel room is shared by 3 students. Drinking water and electricity facilities are available in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a bad college in all terms.

content.Placements: The placements of this college are very bad because we did not get placement in any year. Not a single company came to the college. All the students have to find jobs on their own. The college does not invite any company or enterprise.
content.Infrastructure: We have all the facilities in the college like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc. But only the classrooms are good. Library opens from 8 am to 9 pm, only for one hour. We do not have any hostel in the college.
content.Faculty: The teachers are very good. They solve all our doubts and they are very helpful to us. They do not overburden students. The course does not make us industry ready, according to me. It is an old course. Semester exams are not too hard.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Average college because of low cost but less you get.

content.Placements: From our college, I didn't see anyone who gets an internship and I also didn't see any company come to our college. I asked so many students who graduated from our college but they are not getting a job. I don't know if this is a college problem or a course problem.
content.Infrastructure: In terms of the facilities, I think our college is a little bit better. In our college we have Wi-Fi and that Wi-Fi is good enough to do our studies. But if we talk about our canteen that's very bad. Because in our canteen they only sell some packages of snakes.

individual_reviews.title: The college is too worst, it will take money and all the time and make us search for our own job.

content.Placements: The placements in the college are too bad, when the placement officer is there but not helpful. If the placement is there, it is only for publicity, and after some days the job becomes so hard to get that one has to resign to it, and it is further helpful for next time.
content.Infrastructure: There is no infrastructure and facilities for the students; it is so the worst. We have to adjust to the classroom without fan, proper windows, computers, and all. It is nicely painted from outside to attract new admissions. There is no hostel attached to the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is absolutely not good to choose for study.

content.Placements: College is good. Most of the students are placed in different multinational companies. The percentage of required students in placement is 65%. The higher package is 12 LPA, and lowest is 5 LPA. The internships are very low within the college. There is no internship here.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure on the campus is not good, but it is set up as good to attract new admissions. The toilets are not cleaned. If it is cleaned again, it smells badly. The materials in the lab are only for decorative purposes, they don't work properly. There is no hostel at the college, and students stay at nearly PGs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is absolutely good because of its best nature.

content.Placements: I joined the brilliant institute by hearing the fame, and after the percentage of students was placed at 65%. Nearly 80 members per annum are recruited by the top companies from across Hyderabad city. The internship factor may be less, but the package was good, nearly 7-10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are average in the institute rather than well campus, but here is the present nature far away from Hyderabad city. The labs and departments are on separate floors, the labs are only for looking purpose. There is no hostel attached to the college, but the students come from Hyderabad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is best to enjoy, the worst to study.

content.Placements: I'm presently studying in this college, mostly the college is the best in exam pass percentage, and that is more than 65% which is impossible with other colleges. Some companies come to recruit, but not most. The internship is not with other than the CSE allied branches.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure on the campus is not in good condition, it is not situated where it is supposed to be, and the fans and lights are not under maintenance. The washrooms are not cleaned, and the major problem is with the drinking water. The hostel is not attached to the college, and there is no particular hostel associated with the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is best for those who want to enjoy but average for study.

content.Placements: College is absolutely okay and fine. The placements are just okay. The package is nearly 6 LPA. Internships are not from the side of the college. There is no internship program for Brilliant College. There may be some companies that come to college to hire students for placements. The percentage of students who get internships is nearly 20 to 30%. The highest package is 40 LPA, lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not good. The benches are rarely damaged. There is no insufficient water for drinking. review_summary.college_name: Arunai College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I studied for four years in this college, and it has nothing dissatisfying.

content.Placements: The campus placements are arranged by our college. They invite all the best possible companies to recruit students. If you score above 70%, you can get an internship.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available here. Free Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc., are available. The hostel food is good, but I won't say it is awesome. They allow us to play sports, and the college has a P.E.T sir. He will train us well. We don't have medical facilities in our college, but first-aid kits are available.
content.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, and even if you ask them your doubts many times, they will help you solve the questions. My favorite sir is Raja sir, as he is the most talented. The course and semester exams are easy. You can get 40% easily, and you have to study hard to score high. 40% is the pass percentage.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Our college charges a less and affordable fee.

content.Placements: Students who put effort and work on their subjects will get placed here. The college provides placement training for all the students, but you have to put your own efforts. Mostly IT companies visit our college for provides with a low package.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility was good, and it has very good facilities. Outside food is not allowed inside the hostel. Gadgets are not allowed on both campus and hostel. Students get non-vegetarian food every day. Sports activities and events are conducted in the hostel and the campus, which helps students to become stress-free.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: The campus gives a pleasant atmosphere.

content.Placements: Placements were not up to the level, but academic wise the college was good. They provided all the training programme to attend placements, but you can't expect many companies. A decent salary package was not offered, and the salary package offered was around 2-3 LPA, which was disappointing.
content.Infrastructure: The fee was adorable, but the infrastructure can be improved. The college had many rules and regulations, and many tests were also conducted. Labs were well-equipped and maintained properly, but classrooms infrastructure should be improvised. The campus had many trees, which gives a pleasant atmosphere.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Our college has a very good course curriculum and faculty members.

content.Placements: Arunai College offers average placements for students. During our tenure, placements were not very good, and around 15 to 20 companies visited our college for placements, but they are some local companies. The average salary package offered was 2 LPA. The internship is a part of the course curriculum, so every student must do an internship during their final semester.
content.Infrastructure: The fee at our college is affordable. Arunai College of Engineering is one of the top colleges under Anna University. There are no Wi-Fi facilities on the campus, but the labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The hostel has all the facilities, and there are many rules and regulations to wear dress code.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: One disappointment is about the infrastructure.

content.Placements: The placement is average. Only limited number of companies will be coming. But the college train you well for the industry they'll provide placement training programme for all the students. IT companies will be coming and BPO too. If you are really talented you can get placed.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel has all the facilities like TV, geyser, non veg everyday and cleaned and neat room. Arunai college conducts sports activities and events which they'll split throughout the academic year. No gadgets are allowed inside the campus and many rules regulations inside the hostel such as study hour for two hours.
